title: Mainframe MVS / z/OS System Administrator
description:
Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. 
 The Role As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients - which means some of the biggest in the world.
 
There s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage z/OS system programming initiatives Design resilient and scalable mainframe infrastructure Handle upgrades, migrations, and SMP/E maintenance Manage core components: JES, storage, networking Support CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ subsystems Drive automation, performance, and capacity optimization Resolve critical incidents and perform root cause analysis Ensure security, compliance, and SLA adherence Support disaster recovery and monitoring integration Collaborate with teams, vendors, and stakeholders Mentor team members and drive modernization efforts 
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times Yes! But you ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
 
Your future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. 
 Who You Are You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience 7+ Yrs Expertise in IBM z/OS system programming with strong knowledge of z/OS internals and architecture Proficiency in SMP/E installation, maintenance, and upgrade management Hands-on experience with JES2/JES3 administration and operations In-depth understanding of mainframe storage (DASD, DFSMS, HSM) and networking (TCP/IP, VTAM) Enterprise subsystem support for CICS, DB2, IMS, and MQ Skills in performance tuning, capacity planning, dump analysis, and advanced problem determination Strong root cause analysis capability for critical incidents Experience with automation and scheduling tools on z/OS Expertise in system upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives Knowledge of security administration and compliance management on z/OS Familiarity with disaster recovery and high availability concepts Experience with monitoring and observability tools for mainframe environments Proven ability in production support within SLA-driven environments Understanding of incident, problem, and change management processes Scripting skills using Shell, REXX, or CLIST Experience in vendor coordination and defect resolution Demonstrated leadership in enterprise mainframe operations Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Strong expertise in IBM z/OS architecture design and engineering, including knowledge of Parallel Sysplex and GDPS Hands-on experience with IBM Tivoli, OMEGAMON, NetView, and System Automation tools Proven capability in mainframe automation, self-healing platform implementation, and AIOps-driven observability integration Familiarity with DevOps practices for mainframe environments and hybrid cloud integration Knowledge of z/OS security products such as RACF, ACF2, and Top Secret Experience in capacity forecasting and enterprise optimization strategies Exposure to modernization and transformation programs and defining enterprise operational standards Experience with modern automation frameworks such as Ansible and Zowe Understanding of mainframe API enablement and integration technologies Knowledge of compliance, audit frameworks, and ITIL-based service management practices Cross-platform infrastructure integration experience Strong mentoring, technical leadership, and stakeholder management capabilities Focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives 
 Being You The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That s The Kyndryl Way. 
 What You Can Expect Your career with us isn t just a job-it s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health-because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. 
 
From your very first day, you ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won t just contribute-you ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
 
We re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities-from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. 
 
We want you to thrive here-and we re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact Join us and help shape what s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked How Did You Hear About Us during the application process, select Employee Referral and enter your contacts Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior TQM Manager
description:
Roles and Responsibilities : Develop and implement Total Quality Management (TQM) strategies to improve product quality, process efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Lead cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement and implement corrective actions to achieve business excellence. Collaborate with suppliers to ensure compliance with quality standards and regulations. Analyze data to measure performance metrics such as defect rates, cycle times, and customer complaints. Job Requirements : Develop and drive organization's Total Quality Management (TQM) journey by establishing a structured, long-term roadmap aligned with business objectives and quality excellence standards. Prepare annual TQM implementation plans with clear milestones, deliverables, and performance indicators & Continuously identify improvement opportunities and integrate best practices in quality management across the organization. 2. Training & Capability Building Design, develop, and deliver training programs on TQM principles, methodologies, tools, and best practices for employees across all levels. Conduct awareness sessions, workshops, and knowledge-sharing forums to strengthen the organization's quality culture. Coordinate with external consultants, training institutes, and subject matter experts to organize specialized learning interventions. 3. Functional Support & Consulting Act as the organization's TQM Subject Matter Expert (SME), providing guidance and support to all functions in implementing TQM initiatives. Facilitate cross-functional collaboration to ensure quality improvement projects are aligned with the overall TQM strategy. Support departments in identifying improvement opportunities, problem-solving, process optimization, and deployment of quality tools and methodologies. Provide coaching and mentoring to teams to enhance their understanding and application of TQM practices. 4. Progress Monitoring, Governance & Follow-up Track and monitor the implementation status of TQM initiatives and roadmap activities across all functions. Establish review mechanisms to ensure timely completion of action plans and achievement of quality objectives. Analyze progress, identify risks or bottlenecks, and facilitate corrective actions to address delays and challenges. Prepare periodic management reports, dashboards, and presentations highlighting progress, achievements, key concerns, and recommendations. Conduct regular review meetings with stakeholders and leadership teams to ensure accountability and sustained momentum toward TQM excellence. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of Total Quality Management (TQM), Continuous Improvement, and Business Excellence frameworks. Understanding of Deming Prize/Grand Prize criteria and assessment processes. Training facilitation, coaching, and stakeholder management skills. Project management, planning, and execution capabilities. Data analysis, problem-solving, and progress-tracking expertise. Excellent communication, influencing, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

lead incident response and post-mortems for data issues Act as the technical authority on internal data contracts and API schemas in cross-functional discussions with backend, product, and AI/ML teams Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with a proven track record delivering production-grade pipelines, data models, and storage architectures Deep SQL expertise; hands-on experience designing schemas and tuning queries at production scale Extensive, hands-on experience with AWS cloud data services for storage, compute, messaging, and eventing Advanced Python proficiency for pipeline development; experience structuring code for maintainability and reuse Proven experience designing and operating event-driven architectures and queue-based or streaming ingestion systems Strong data modeling skills across both OLTP and OLAP workloads, with the ability to balance normalization, query performance, and downstream analytics needs Deep understanding of data security and compliance practices: field-level encryption, IAM least-privilege, PII classification, and audit trail design Experience setting team-level standards: data contracts, schema registries, lineage tracking, or data quality frameworks Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience building data infrastructure for LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or agentic AI systems on AWS Demonstrated experience operating in a serverless-first environment and making principled architectural decisions on cost, scalability, and performance AWS certifications (Data Engineer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, or equivalent)

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview 
Under the mission of "Money Forward. Move your life forward," Money Forward aims to resolve the financial concerns and anxieties of individuals and businesses through the power of technology.
We have partnered with Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation to establish a new company in preparation for the launch of a new digital bank.
We are currently seeking candidates for the position of Data Engineer as part of this initiative.
*Based on the press release announced on April 16, 2025.

 This position involves employment with Money Forward, Inc., and a secondment to the new company (SMBC Money Forward Bank Preparatory Corporation). The evaluation system and employee benefits will follow the policies of Money Forward, Inc.

 Responsibilities and Duties 
As a Mid-level Data Engineer in the MIDAS (Management Integration & Data Analytics System) Data Platform Team, you will build from scratch and maintain the central data hub connecting most systems within one of Japan's more innovative digital banks. You will work with modern cloud-based data technologies to ingest data from various banking systems, apply complex business logic, and serve it to downstream systems for enterprise management, regulatory reporting, risk management, and many other applications. Due to the high expectations in the banking domain, you will face complex data engineering challenges including data quality, reconciliation across systems, time-critical data processing, and complete traceability. This mid-level position allows you to work with increasing independence on data pipeline development while collaborating closely with senior engineers and the technical lead for guidance on complex problems. 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 5-8 years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering
 Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python
 Hands-on experience building data pipelines using tools like Databricks, dbt, or similar
 Experience with AWS and its object storage
 Understanding of data modeling concepts including dimensional modeling and fact/dimension tables
 Experience with data quality validation and testing
 Ability to debug and troubleshoot data pipeline issues
 Experience with version control (Git) and basic understanding of CI/CD concepts
 Understanding of basic data governance: access control and audit logging
 Good problem-solving skills and ability to work with moderate independence
 Good communication skills and willingness to ask questions when blocked
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 Preferred Skills and Experience 
While not specifically required, tell us if you have any of the following.
 Experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated industries
 Basic knowledge of banking domain concepts: core banking, payments, or regulatory reporting
 Exposure to data platforms in regulated environments (FISC Guidelines, GDPR, APPI)
 Hands-on experience with Databricks platform or AWS native data services
 Experience with performance tuning: partitioning strategies, file formats, query optimization
 Experience building REST APIs with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or similar)
 Knowledge of streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
 Basic experience with Terraform
 Experience with BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Looker, PowerBI)
 Experience with data visualization and dashboard design
 Interest in obtaining certifications (AWS Certified Data Analytics, Databricks certifications)
 Experience in AI development and/or experience in using AI tools to improve development processes.
 Money Forward recently announced our AI Strategy roadmap which focuses on improving AI-driven operational efficiencies, as well as integrating AI agents into our products to deliver better value to our users. 
 Technology Stack 
 Cloud Infrastructure :
 AWS (primary cloud platform in Tokyo region)
 S3 for data lake storage with VPC networking for secure connectivity
 AWS IAM for security and access management
 Data Lakehouse Architecture :
 Modern lakehouse architecture using Delta Lake for ACID transactions, time-travel, and schema evolution
 Columnar storage formats (Parquet) optimized for analytics
 Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture for progressive data refinement
 Partition strategies and Z-ordering for query performance
 Unity Catalog for centralized governance and metadata management
 Orchestration & Processing :
 Databricks Workflows for managed workflow orchestration
 Distributed data processing with Apache Spark on Databricks clusters
 Serverless compute and auto-scaling clusters for cost optimization
 Streaming and batch ingestion patterns with Databricks AutoLoader
 Data Transformation :
 dbt (data build tool) for SQL-based analytics engineering
 Delta Live Tables for declarative ETL pipelines with built-in data quality
 SQL and Python for data transformations
 Incremental materialization strategies for efficiency
 Query & Analytics :
 Databricks SQL for high-performance analytics queries
 Serverless and auto-scaling SQL warehouses for variable workloads
 Auto-scaling compute for variable workloads
 Query result caching and optimization
 REST APIs for data serving to downstream consumers
 Data Quality & Governance :
 Automated data quality with Delta Live Tables expectations and Great Expectations
 Cross-system reconciliation and validation logic
 Fine-grained access control with column/row-level security using Unity Catalog
 Automated data lineage tracking for regulatory compliance
 Audit logging and 10-year data retention policies
 Business Intelligence :
 Amazon QuickSight and/or Databricks SQL Dashboards
 Integration with enterprise BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) 
 Version Control : GitHub
 CI/CD : GitHub Actions
 Infrastructure as Code : Terraform
 Monitoring : Databricks monitoring, AWS CloudWatch integration
 AI-Assisted Development : Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT
 Development Structure 
We operate in a small, agile team while collaborating closely with partners from the banking industry. The MIDAS team is growing rapidly, aiming for more than 10 data engineers within this year. 
 Location: Chennai
 Work Mode: Hybrid 3 days from office and 2 days work from home.

title: Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration
description:
Description: 
 Network Engineer – AWS & Cisco Migration 
 Requirements: 
 Role Summary 
We are seeking a highly skilled Network Engineer with deep expertise in Cisco networking technologies and AWS cloud networking to lead and execute the migration of onpremises and Ciscobased network infrastructure into AWS. This role will be responsible for designing, building, securing, and operating hybrid and cloudnative network architectures while modernizing legacy Cisco environments.
The ideal candidate has handson experience with Cisco firewalls, routing/switching, VPNs, and BGP, combined with strong practical knowledge of AWS VPC design, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and cloud security controls.   Required Qualifications 7+ years of professional experience as a Network Engineer, with strong Cisco networking background. 3+ years of handson experience designing and supporting AWS networking. Deep expertise in Cisco routing and switching, including BGP and OSPF. Strong experience with Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and VPN technologies. Solid understanding of AWS VPCs, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Elastic Load Balancing. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network issues in production environments. Experience migrating largescale enterprise networks from Cisco to AWS. Handson experience with Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation. Familiarity with container networking (EKS, Kubernetes CNI). AWS and/or Cisco certifications such as:
- AWS Advanced Networking – Specialty
- CCNP Enterprise or CCNP Security 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Cisco to AWS Migration Lead network migration initiatives from Cisco onpremises and datacenter environments to AWS. Assess existing Cisco architectures (ASA/FTD, routers, switches) and define migration strategies to AWSnative or virtualized equivalents (ASAv/FTDv, Transit Gateway, AWS Network Firewall). Migrate and validate ACLs, NAT rules, VPNs (SitetoSite and Client VPN), and routing policies in AWS. AWS Networking & Hybrid Connectivity Design and implement AWS VPC architectures, including CIDR planning, subnets, routing tables, gateways (IGW/NAT), and security boundaries. Build and operate hybrid connectivity using SitetoSite VPN and AWS Direct Connect with BGP and high availability. Implement Transit Gateway architectures for largescale, multiaccount environments. Network Security & Compliance Deploy and manage Cisco firewalls (ASA, FTD, ASAv/FTDv) and/or AWSnative security services. Implement network security best practices using security groups, NACLs, and logging (VPC Flow Logs). Support compliance initiatives (SOC, PCI, HIPAA where applicable) through secure network design and documentation. Automation, Operations & Troubleshooting Use Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation) to standardize and automate network deployments. Troubleshoot complex network issues across Layer 3–7 in hybrid and cloud environments. Leverage AWS tooling such as Reachability Analyzer, CloudWatch, and traffic monitoring to ensure network reliability. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational documentation. 
 What We Offer: 
 Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities! Work-Life Balance: GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. Fun Perks: We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

description:
About Foundever: 
We are Foundever. Our 150,000 people across the globe connect many of the world s best-known brands with their customers - 9 million times every day. As a global leader in customer experience (CX) management, we deliver experiences through voice, chat, social media and for 400+ clients, from Fortune 500 companies to startups. We value creativity, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. Join our team and be part of a culture that fosters growth and advancement. Overview The Principal Windows Endpoint Engineer is the technical authority responsible for defining, training, and leading the enterprise endpoint management strategy. This role ensures all Windows endpoints are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with HIPAA, PCI, and internal security standards. The Principal Engineer drives modernization initiatives, leads cross-functional engineering efforts, and provides expert-level guidance across the organization. This position is hands-on and works as the bridge between Engineering and Architecture teams, with a strong emphasis on strategy, automation, governance, and technical leadership. Essential Duties & Responsibilities Architecture & Strategy Ensure standardisation across Foundever s enterprise Windows endpoint architecture - including Intune, SCCM/MECM, Autopilot, and related lifecycle technologies. Lead the transition toward cloud-native, Intune-first endpoint management and Zero Trust-aligned device strategies. Maintain hardened baseline configurations aligned with HIPAA, PCI, CIS, and NIST frameworks. Work with Architecture teams to establish and coordinate engineering standards, governance models, and long-term roadmaps for endpoint management. Evaluate emerging technologies and drive adoption of modern endpoint capabilities. Technical Leadership Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues across engineering, security, and operations teams. Mentor engineers and guide best practices in automation, configuration management, and endpoint security. Represent endpoint engineering in standards boards, security reviews, and cross-functional technical forums. Provide expert consultation to leadership on endpoint strategy, risk, and modernization initiatives. Deployment & Automation Maintain and optimize OS and application deployment strategies using Intune, Autopilot, and SCCM/MECM. Develop enterprise-grade PowerShell automation and reusable tooling to support configuration, compliance, and lifecycle operations. Oversee co-management or migration strategies between SCCM and Intune. Security & Compliance Own endpoint audit readiness for HIPAA, PCI, and internal security assessments. Partner with Security teams to design and enforce endpoint security controls, including ASR rules, BitLocker, Defender for Endpoint, and Conditional Access policies. Ensure endpoint configurations meet enterprise security baselines and regulatory requirements. Lead remediation strategies for endpoint vulnerabilities and compliance gaps. Collaboration & Influence Work closely with Networking, Security, Identity, and Infrastructure teams to ensure cohesive endpoint architecture. Provide technical leadership during major deployments, client onboarding, and enterprise-wide initiatives. Deliver training, documentation, and knowledge sharing to engineering and support teams. Required Qualifications 10+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, systems administration, or enterprise device management. Expert-level knowledge of Windows endpoint operating systems, including Windows 11. Deep hands-on experience architecting and administering Intune/Endpoint Manager, Autopilot, and SCCM/MECM. Advanced PowerShell scripting and automation capabilities. Strong expertise in Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, networking fundamentals, and identity-driven device management. Proven experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, PCI, or similar). Strong understanding of Zero Trust principles and endpoint security hardening. Preferred Qualifications Relevant certifications such as: Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert CompTIA Security+ or equivalent ITIL Foundation Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, or configuration-as-code approaches. Familiarity with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V). Experience designing large-scale SCCM infrastructures (DPs, SUP, SQL, HA).

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 The Data Center Engineer is responsible for the management, maintenance, and deployment of the physical infrastructure within the data center. This role involves both building and operational support activities to ensure optimal data center performance and reliability.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 The roles and responsibilities of the build and support Engineer are:
   

  

 Operational activities (not limited to):
   

  

* Work on tickets assigned to fix incidents in the data center on\-site visit is required
* Timely updates with accurate work logs to be updated in ticketing tool.
* Meet all agreed SLA’s with the Customer.
* Immediately escalate to the central project team any abnormal situation in the data center concerning Ericsson equipment at site.
* Asset Management onsite at the data center and reporting
* Site audit conducted as per the official guidelines
* Site spare inventory management and reporting
* Remote support to the onsite engineer to solve the issue
* Support other projects within META program.


 Build activities (Not limited to):
   

  

* Installation and commissioning of compute and network racks.
* Fibre and copper cable laying, termination, labelling, and dressing.
* Installation and configuration support for network and compute devices.
* Material receipt, verification, and inventory management.
* Performing troubleshooting for hardware, link, and connectivity issues.
* Engaging with customers, vendors, and internal teams for issue resolution.


**The Skills You Bring**
* Proven experience in remote troubleshooting and ability to operate effectively in a service desk or data centre environment.
* Willingness to work during non\-business hours or in shifts as required by operational needs.

Implement BM25, hybrid search, rank fusion, metadata filtering, and cross-encoder reranking. Develop context assembly and citation mechanisms for grounded responses. Build retrieval evaluation frameworks using Recall@K, nDCG, MRR, groundedness, and golden Q&A datasets. Monitor retrieval quality and use evaluation metrics to drive improvements. Design incremental and delta ingestion pipelines and support live corpus re-indexing. Build reliable production services with queue/worker patterns, retries, idempotency, and dead-letter handling. Strong experience with Python and FastAPI in production environments. Hands-on experience with hybrid retrieval using dense embeddings and BM25. Experience with vector databases and metadata filtering. Strong understanding of embedding models, retrieval strategies, rank fusion, and reranking. Experience with cross-encoder reranking. Practical experience with retrieval evaluation metrics such as Recall@K, MRR, nDCG, and groundedness. Strong experience with document processing, OCR, PDF/PPTX/DOCX extraction, and document AI pipelines. Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, structured output, and metadata extraction. Hands-on AWS experience with services such as S3, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Bedrock, Textract, or OpenSearch. Experience with Docker, pytest, Git, CI/CD, structured logging, and distributed service patterns. title: Robotic Intern
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for students looking to kick-start their careers. Please review the Job Description shared below and apply if your skills and interests align with the role. 
 Position:  Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development (Internship)
 Location:  Ahmedabad (Fx31Labs Office)
 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424 
 Job Description: Fx31Labs is seeking a passionate and hands-on Robotics Intern Autonomous Systems & Prototype Development  to join our advanced robotics team. This internship offers a fast-paced, end-to-end engineering experience involving aerial robotics, embedded systems, autonomous navigation, perception, and real-world prototype development.This role is ideal for students and early-career engineers looking to gain practical experience in designing, building, testing, and improving autonomous robotic platforms. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design & Build Assemble and integrate motors, ESCs, sensors, flight controllers, microcontrollers, and communication modules. Design and prototype electronic systems for rapid testing and development. Assist in mechanical assembly, wiring, and hardware integration of robotic platforms. Embedded Systems & Control Develop Python and C/C++ software for sensor integration, control systems, and autonomous behaviors. Interface with hardware using UART, CAN, IC, SPI, USB, and wireless communication protocols. Implement safety mechanisms, telemetry systems, and fault-detection routines. Autonomous Navigation & Perception Integrate sensors such as IMUs, GPS, LiDAR, cameras, depth sensors, and range finders. Develop and test localization, navigation, and obstacle-avoidance capabilities. Work with computer vision and perception pipelines for environmental awareness. ROS 2 & SLAM Implement and tune SLAM and localization frameworks using ROS 2. Work with tools such as Cartographer, RTAB-Map, Nav2, and related autonomy stacks. Support mapping, path planning, and autonomous mission execution. System Integration & Testing Integrate hardware, firmware, and software into a fully functional robotic system. Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and validation across electronics, software, and mechanical subsystems. Conduct field testing and analyze system performance. Rapid Prototyping & Iteration Build, test, evaluate, and refine prototypes through iterative development cycles. Document experiments, test results, and design improvements. Contribute innovative ideas to improve system reliability and performance. Team Collaboration Collaborate closely with robotics, embedded, AI, mechanical, and software engineers. Participate in design reviews, sprint planning, testing sessions, and technical discussions. Present findings, challenges, and proposed solutions to the engineering team. 
 Qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Hands-on experience with robotics, embedded systems, drones, autonomous vehicles, or related projects. Proficiency in Python and basic C/C++ programming. Understanding of sensors, control systems, communication protocols, and microcontroller-based development. Experience with hardware assembly, wiring, debugging, and soldering. Comfortable working on both software and physical hardware systems. 
 Nice-to-Haves: Experience with ROS 2 and robotic middleware. Knowledge of SLAM, localization, path planning, and autonomous navigation. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar robotics/autonomy frameworks. Familiarity with OpenCV, computer vision, or AI-based perception systems. Experience with Linux (Ubuntu) development environments. Familiarity with CAD tools such as Fusion 360, SolidWorks, or Onshape. Understanding of wireless communication systems and telemetry. 
 Soft Skills: Self-driven and highly proactive. Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Curious mindset with a passion for building real-world robotic systems. Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a rapid prototyping environment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. 
 Why Join Us? End-to-End Engineering Experience:   Work on complete autonomous robotic systems from design and prototyping to testing and deployment. Advanced Robotics Exposure:   Gain hands-on experience in embedded systems, aerial robotics, autonomous navigation, perception, and ROS 2-based autonomy. Learning & Mentorship:   Collaborate with experienced engineers and receive practical guidance in real-world R&D projects. Innovation-Driven Environment:   Be part of a team focused on rapid prototyping, experimentation, and cutting-edge technology development. 
 Internship Details: Duration:  3–6 Months
 Type:  Internship with mentorship, certification, and learning opportunities
 Location:  On-site at Fx31Labs, Ahmedabad 
 About Fx31Labs: Fx31Labs is an innovation-driven tech company delivering solutions at the intersection of robotics, AI, and software development. We specialize in building intelligent, scalable, and automation-first systems for startups and enterprises alike.

description:
Junior Design Verification Engineer (0-2 Years)
 Position details Company: Raiton Semiconductor Pvt. Ltd. Location: Bangalore, India (client-site / hybrid, as per project) Experience: 02 years in ASIC/SoC functional verification (fresh graduates with strong project or internship experience are welcome) Employment type: Full-time Apply to: careers@raitonsemi.com 
 
 Role summary 
 Own block- and subsystem-level verification for IPs and SoC subsystems built on industry-standard protocols. Develop and maintain UVM environments; write and debug tests; drive coverage closure. Work directly with design, architecture and client teams to sign off features on schedule. Write C-based tests for processor-driven verification where the program requires it. Contribute to functional-safety verification activities on automotive programs. Key responsibilities Understand design specifications and protocol standards; contribute to verification plans, test lists and coverage models. Write UVM sequences, tests and checkers within existing testbenches; build new agents or scoreboards for smaller blocks. Develop C bare-metal tests for CPU-driven verification of RISC-V or ARM subsystems (boot, memory-map access, interrupts, DMA, peripheral programming). Verify blocks and interfaces in one or more of: RISC-V/ARM processor subsystems, DDR4/DDR5/LPDDR5 and HBM memory controllers, PCIe endpoints/root ports. Verify AMBA-based interconnects and peripherals (AXI, AHB, APB), including protocol checking and transaction-level scoreboarding. Debug simulation failures to root cause using waveform and log analysis; file and track issues with design teams. Add functional coverage and SystemVerilog Assertions; analyze coverage reports and write tests to close holes. Run regressions, triage failures and keep regression health reports up to date. Document tests, results and status clearly for internal and client reviews. Required skills and experience 0–2 years of experience in ASIC/SoC/FPGA functional verification, or strong academic/internship projects in verification. Good knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM: classes, constraints, randomization, sequences, drivers/monitors, scoreboards, factory and config DB. Working knowledge of C: pointers, structures, bit manipulation, memory-mapped register access; ability to write and debug bare-metal test code. Exposure to at least one of: RISC-V or ARM processor subsystems, DDR/LPDDR or HBM memory controllers, PCIe. Good understanding of AMBA bus protocols (AXI, AHB, APB): channels, handshakes, bursts, ordering and response handling. Strong digital design fundamentals: FSMs, FIFOs, arbitration, clock-domain crossing, reset, timing basics. Familiarity with functional coverage and SystemVerilog Assertions. Hands-on with at least one simulator (VCS, Xcelium or Questa) and a waveform debugger (Verdi or equivalent). Basic scripting in Python, Perl or Tcl; comfortable in a Linux environment. Familiarity with Git or Perforce. Clear communication, willingness to learn protocols in depth, and ability to work in a client-facing team. Good to have Internship or project work on UVM testbench development for a real IP or subsystem. Exposure to RISC-V ISA (RV32/RV64, privileged spec) or ARM Cortex-A/M/R architecture. Exposure to DDR/LPDDR/HBM protocol basics: commands, timing parameters, refresh, training. Exposure to PCIe basics: TLP/DLLP, link training (LTSSM), configuration space. Awareness of low-power (UPF) or gate-level simulation concepts. Exposure to functional safety (ISO 26262) or fault simulation. Participation in RISC-V, VLSI or verification contests, open-source hardware projects, or relevant certifications. Education B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, VLSI or Computer Engineering , or equivalent.

title: Active Directory and Office 365 Administrator
description:
Job Description: 
 Active Directory & Office 365 Administrator 
 Seeking a Skilled Active Directory and Office 365 Expert Position Overview 
 We are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented Active Directory and Office 365 Administrator to join our IT team. This position requires a deep understanding of directory services, cloud collaboration platforms, identity and access management, security best practices, and enterprise-level system administration. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with the design, deployment, and maintenance of Active Directory environments and Office 365 tenant management, as well as a passion for optimizing workflow, ensuring security, and proactively supporting users across the organization. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Active Directory Administration: Design, deploy, and manage Active Directory domains, forests, organizational units (OUs), and Group Policy Objects (GPOs). Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to authentication, replication, trusts, and domain controllers. Manage user and computer accounts, security groups, and service accounts with strict adherence to access control policies. Implement and maintain security protocols, including password policies, auditing, and privileged access management. Oversee the integration of Active Directory with other platforms and services, such as Entra ID and third-party applications. Conduct periodic reviews and clean-up of AD objects to maintain a healthy and efficient directory structure. 
 Office 365 Administration: 
 Manage the Office 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Teams, and other integrated services. Provision and manage user licenses, mailboxes, distribution groups, and shared mailboxes. Monitor service health, usage reports, and audit logs to ensure optimal performance and compliance. Assist users and departments with troubleshooting and resolving Office 365-related issues. Implement and maintain policies for email retention, archiving, eDiscovery, and litigation hold. 
 Support and Training: 
 Provide Tier 3 technical support for Active Directory and Office 365-related incidents. Serve as the primary point of contact for escalated issues and critical system outages. Develop and deliver technical documentation, user guides, and training sessions for staff and IT colleagues. Collaborate with helpdesk, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure seamless support and workflow integration. 
 Project Management: 
 Lead or participate in IT projects related to directory services upgrades, Office 365 feature rollouts, and system integrations. Contribute to planning, budgeting, and risk analysis for infrastructure initiatives. Coordinate with vendors and external partners for system enhancements, troubleshooting, and product evaluations. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent work experience). Minimum 7 years experience with Active Directory and Office 365 administration in mid to large enterprise environments. Deep knowledge of AD architecture, replication, GPOs, and security. Hands-on expertise with Office 365 administration—Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and licensing. Strong experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. Familiarity with Entra ID, hybrid identity models, and cloud migration best practices. Thorough understanding of IT security, compliance, and audit standards, especially regarding user identity and data protection. Proven track record in troubleshooting complex directory and cloud service issues. Excellent communication, documentation, and organizational skills. Relevant certifications highly preferred. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with hybrid Exchange environments. Demonstrated capacity for critical thinking and proactive system optimization. Ability to mentor and train IT staff and end-users on best practices. Project management experience and a history of successful system deployments.

Key Skills: Group Policy Objects (GPOs),o365 administration,Active directory adminsitration,organizational units (OUs),exchange online,Exchange Server,powershell scripting,SharePoint Online Development

title: SAP CPI Consultant
description:
SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) Consultant 

 
 
 We are seeking an experienced SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) Consultant to design, develop, and support enterprise integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP systems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in SAP Integration Suite (CPI), integration design, API development, message mappings, scripting, and cloud integration technologies. The role requires close collaboration with functional teams, business stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing integration solutions. 
 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Independently design, develop, configure, and deploy SAP CPI integration flows based on functional and technical requirements. Develop complex integration scenarios using SAP CPI adapters, message mappings, value mappings, XSLT mappings, and Groovy/JavaScript scripting. Build and maintain integrations between SAP and non-SAP applications using SOAP, REST, OData, IDoc, RFC, SFTP, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Salesforce, and other standard connectors. Execute unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and troubleshoot integration issues to ensure stable and high-performing interfaces. Collaborate with SAP Functional Consultants, technical teams, external vendors, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver integration solutions. Monitor SAP CPI integration runtimes, message processing, and proactively resolve interface failures, exceptions, and performance bottlenecks. Enhance and optimize existing integration interfaces to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including Technical Design Documents (TDD), interface specifications, deployment guides, test cases, and operational manuals. Support deployments across Cloud and Hybrid/On-Premise environments and coordinate with infrastructure teams for connectivity, security certificates, and environment setup. Ensure compliance with SAP integration best practices, governance standards, security policies, and organizational development guidelines. 
 

 Required Skills 
 Strong experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (SAP CPI) / SAP Integration Suite. Hands-on experience with SOAP, REST APIs, OData, IDoc, RFC, XML, JSON, and XSLT. Experience in developing Groovy Scripts and JavaScript within SAP CPI. Strong knowledge of Message Mapping, Value Mapping, Content Modifier, Router, Splitter, Gather, Exception Subprocess, and Process Direct adapters. Experience with SAP Cloud Connector, API Management, and Event-Based Integrations. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP IBP, SAP C4C, or other SAP applications. Good understanding of integration monitoring, security certificates, authentication mechanisms (OAuth, Basic, JWT), and error handling. Experience with transport management, version control, and deployment processes. 
 

 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with SAP Integration Suite API Management. Knowledge of BTP (Business Technology Platform). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience integrating SAP with third-party cloud applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 

 
 

 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. SAP CPI/SAP Integration Suite Certification is an added advantage. 

 
 

 Key Competencies 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Ability to work independently and manage multiple integration projects. Strong documentation and technical writing skills. Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional teams. 
 
 Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Bangalore

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company Profile - 
 Healthedge is an agile and innovative 21st century software company focused on providing 
 next-generation, business-transforming technology products to the healthcare payer market. 
 We enable our customers to radically innovate, drastically reduce costs, and efficiently address 
 the business imperatives of the evolving healthcare economy. Healthedge is headquartered in 
 Burlington, MA (USA) with development offices in Hyderabad (India), Bangalore (India), Pune 
 (India) and Powell, OH (USA). 
 Healthedge has been listed as a sample vendor for Next-Generation Core Administrative 
 Systems in Gartners 2017 hype cycle for U.S. healthcare payers. 
 Additionally, Healthedge is a proud winner of 3 awards from Comparably : Best Company Work
 Life Balance, Happiest Employees of 2024, and Best Company Perks & Benefits! These awards only 
 reinforces what we’ve known all along: the best and brightest work at Healthedge. 
 Designation: Senior Software Engineer 
 Location: Hyderabad 
 About the Role : 
 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and scale next
 generation healthcare technology solutions that improve patient outcomes, streamline clinical 
 workflows, and drive operational efficiency across health systems. The ideal candidate will 
 bring deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem, a passion for engineering excellence, and a proven 
 track record of delivering high-impact, production-grade systems in complex, regulated 
 domains. 
 This role sits at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation — offering the 
 opportunity to architect and shape products that serve millions of patients and truly make a 
 difference. If you thrive on solving hard problems at scale, care deeply about code quality and 
 system resilience, and want your engineering work to have real-world impact beyond business 
 metrics — we'd love to hear from you. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design, develop, and deliver production-grade software as per defined requirements 
 and technical specifications, ensuring adherence to healthcare domain standards and 
 compliance frameworks. 
 • Build and maintain user interfaces, databases, APIs, and client-facing displays across our 
 healthcare platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end user experiences for our end users. 
 • Initiate and drive technical design — architect complex application features, evaluate 
 design trade-offs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term 
 system maintainability. 
 • Produce well-organized, optimized, and thoroughly documented source code in line 
 with established coding guidelines and best practices, maintaining a high bar for 
 readability and consistency. 
 • Debug, troubleshoot, and refine existing source code — identify root causes efficiently, 
 polish feature sets, and improve system performance and reliability with every release 
 cycle. 
 • Contribute to technical design documentation — author and maintain architecture 
 decision records (ADRs), design specs, and runbooks that enable the team to move fast 
 without breaking things. 
 • Build and execute comprehensive unit and integration test cases to ensure code quality, 
 reduce regression risk, and maintain confidence in every deployment. 
 • Test features in controlled, real-world scenarios before go-live — participate in staging 
 validations, UAT coordination, and production rollout monitoring to ensure zero
 disruption releases. 
 • Innovate and develop high-value technology solutions that streamline clinical 
 workflows, reduce manual overhead, and unlock new capabilities for healthcare 
 providers and patients. 
 • Coordinate with fellow engineers and cross-functional teams — collaborate closely with 
 product managers, clinicians, QA, DevOps, data science, and compliance teams to 
 deliver cohesive, high-quality solutions. 
 • Work independently when required — take ownership of ambiguous problems, drive 
 them to resolution with minimal handholding, and communicate progress proactively 
 to stakeholders. 
 • Maintain meticulous attention to detail — every task, from code reviews to 
 documentation to production deployments, must be carried out to the highest standard 
 of quality and precision. 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. 
 • 5+ years of total software development experience. 
 • Proven experience building and delivering complex, scalable software systems — 
 preferably in the healthcare domain. 
 • Strong programming expertise in C# and the .NET framework. 
 • Working experience in MVC architecture is a must. 
 • Hands on experience with Design patterns and Entity frameworks is a must. 
 • Strong hands-on experience with Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or 
 MySQL), Expert-level knowledge of SQL queries including stored procedures, functions 
 and views. 
 • Experience with UI frameworks such as Angular or React (added advantage). Working 
 experience on client-side technologies such as JavaScript, jQuery is required. 
 • Demonstrated proficiency in automation testing and adherence to Test-Driven 
 Development (TDD) principles. 
 • Solid experience in CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, with exposure to 
 automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 • Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure or AWS) and containerization (Docker, 
 Kubernetes) is preferred. 
 • Ability to work independently and in small teams, adaptability to a fast-paced 
 environment and a keen interest in staying current with the latest trends. 
 • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. 
 Why Join Us: 
 • Be part of a mission-driven organization revolutionizing healthcare delivery through 
 technology. 
 • Collaborate with product, clinical, and data teams solving real-world healthcare 
 challenges. 
 • Work with a technically strong team that values innovation, integrity, and impact. 
 • Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and significant career growth 
 opportunities.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
Job Summary About the Role We are shaping the era of pervasive intelligence - where smart systems, AI-powered innovation, and advanced silicon design define how the world connects and computes. This role is built for security-minded engineers who love solving complex technical problems, automating repetitive tasks, and learning cutting-edge tools across cloud, networking, and cybersecurity domains. You will support global infrastructure - spanning data centers, cloud environments, and secure enterprise networks - while developing automation solutions that enhance speed, consistency, and security. You are eager to grow and learn, embracing new challenges and opportunities to advance your career in network security. You will be responsible for supporting all global network services, including LAN, WAN, data center, remote access, wireless, and firewall security. What You'll Be Doing Design, configure, deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot production network infrastructure and associated services. Design and implement network security standards and access controls following NIST frameworks. Develop and implement network security policies and procedures. Design and implement campus and data center macro- and micro-segmentation policies. Utilize automation tools and scripts to standardize deployment configurations and environments. Monitor and analyze networks for potential security threats and vulnerabilities. Manage network security infrastructure including SASE, firewalls, VPNs, and ZTA solutions. Help maintain and advance Zero Trust Architecture adoption. Develop and enforce best-practice security standards, compliance, and governance. Conduct external and internal security audits and assessments to identify potential risks and vulnerabilities in the network infrastructure, adhering to industry-standard cybersecurity frameworks. Stay up to date on emerging network security threats and proofs of concept. Create and maintain documentation of network security designs, processes, and procedures. Identify and solve problems related to overall security infrastructure performance, efficiency, and availability in a timely manner. Contribute to network and security support ticketing and provide timely resolution for end-user issues. Fine-tune and adapt compliance automation scripts for new solutions. The Impact You'll Have Improve reliability and speed of security operations through automation and AI tools. Enhance the organization's network security posture through the implementation of new vendor solutions. Ensure compliance with network security standards, governance, and industry best practices. Provide critical support for global remote field offices and data centers, ensuring secure and reliable network connectivity. Utilize automation to streamline deployment configurations, improving efficiency and consistency. Support the advancement and maintenance of Zero Trust Architecture, reinforcing the organization's security framework. Contribute to the resolution of network security issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring business continuity. Requirements 7+ years of experience working on current, industry-leading (Gartner Leaders) technologies. Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Proficiency in network configuration management and automation tools (Python, Ansible, OpenStack, Terraform). Familiarity with REST API automation and configuration-management secure coding. General knowledge of NIST, CIS Benchmark, and/or STIG security frameworks. Strong experience with zero-day mitigation and remediation. Experience with MFA, SSO, and SAML deployment. Certifications such as PCNSE, ZIA/ZPA, CCNP, CCDP, CCIE, CISSP, CCDE, CEH, or Security+ (or equivalent work experience) are a strong plus. Familiarity with Cisco ACI and application service chaining. Familiarity with Aruba ClearPass NAC. Deep understanding of network security systems and protocols such as IPSec, IKE, GRE, TACACS, RADIUS, 802.1x, OSPF, DMVPN, BGP, and SD-WAN. Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco, Versa, and Aruba devices. Experience configuring Palo Alto, Zscaler, and SASE solutions. Knowledge of frontier AI threat risk and prevention. Ability to work after hours to support projects and maintenance activities. Well-versed in automation and scripting tools such as Python and Ansible. Ability to create best-practice secure environment diagrams and documentation. Ability to quickly learn new or unfamiliar technologies and products using documentation and online resources. Strong verbal, written, interpersonal, and communication skills. Good to Have Knowledge of quantum-resistant encryption and migration planning. Exposure to AI/ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or Azure ML. Cloud experience in GCP, Azure, and AWS. Experience working in a global team environment and solving problems independently. Master's degree in Network or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity.

description:

Interview Date: 18 Sep - 19 Sep
Timing: 10.00 AM - 4.00 PM
Venue: Trichy
Contact: Nandhini (9154350258)

Job Description 
Position: Structural Design Engineer AutoCAD Plant 3D, Autodesk Inventor
 Role Overview 
Structural Engineer will be responsible for the structural design and analysis of HVAC equipment & Infrastructure. The role involves frame analysis, connection design, and load-bearing validation using industry-standard tools. The engineer will ensure all designs comply with applicable structural steel standards and regional building codes across global markets.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and analyse structural components for HVAC product & infrastructure including raised access floor systems, structural ceiling grids, containment systems, and liquid cooling support structures (manifolds, brackets, frames). Perform structural calculations for static and dynamic loading, including point load, uniformly distributed load, seismic, and fatigue considerations for raised floor pedestals, stringers, and panels. Carry out load-bearing capacity analysis and deflection checks for structural ceiling grids supporting suspended high loads. Develop and validate structural design of steel frames, brackets, and support structures for containment systems and liquid cooling manifolds. Create detailed 2D drawings and 3D models of structural assemblies for manufacturing and field installation. Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM) and coordinate design inputs with manufacturing, sourcing, and quality teams. Application of Design Codes & Load Standards - AISC 360 / Eurocode 3 (EN 1993) Usage of Piping / Manifold-Related Standards - ASME B31.3, Process piping code Support new product development and design-for-manufacturing initiatives for floor, ceiling, and containment product lines. Ensure all designs comply with applicable structural steel standards, regional building codes, and internal QA requirements. Prepare technical documentation design calculation reports, structural drawings, specification sheets for client and internal review. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve structural design issues during execution. Participate in design reviews, root-cause investigations for structural failures/non-conformances, and continuous improvement of design standards Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering / Mechanical Engineering Masters degree preferably ME/MS in Structural Engineering 8 to 10 Yrs of experience in Structural design for HVAC equipment. Soft Tools: Highly proficient in STAAD.Pro RISA-3D RISAConnection IDEA StatiCa 
 Strong knowledge of structural design codes and engineering standards. Experience in power generation plants, oil & gas, or heavy industrial projects. Ability to interpret P&IDs, equipment layouts, and piping drawings. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

Key Skills: Autodesk Inventor,Structural Design,AutoCAD,Design Engineering,Plant 3D,Inventor,Plant,Autodesk

JD: Piping Design Engineer (PTC Onshape / Creo / Solidworks) 
 Job Description Summary 
We are seeking a technically sound Piping system Design Engineer to support Design & engineering of piping systems for data centre liquid cooling and mechanical infrastructure. The role involves detailed 3D piping layout, 3D piping modelling, piping routing, fabrication/spool drawings, BOM development, stress analysis coordination, and adherence to recognised piping design codes, working closely with mechanical, structural and project engineering teams.
Experience in data centre cooling, HVAC, Chilled water, Refrigeration, or similar mechanical infrastructure is preferred. Candidates with strong piping design experience from Oil & Gas/process piping industries may also be considered.
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Develop piping layout drawings, isometrics, and routing plans for data centre liquid cooling loops. Prepare piping general arrangement (GA) drawings, P&IDs support drawings, Fabrication drawings Interpret P&IDs, piping schematics, engineering sketches and equipment layouts and translate them into accurate 3D piping models. Perform piping routing studies considering equipment layout, structural constraints, accessibility and maintainability. Consider installation, fabrication, weldability, maintenance clearances and design-for-manufacturability requirements during piping routing and modelling. Coordinate pipe stress analysis requirement, work with Stress analysis team to resolve support and routing conflicts. Prepare & update Bills of Material (BOM) for piping components, fittings, valves, supports & accessories. Develop fabrication and spool drawings including relevant dimensions, component information and fabrication requirements. Ensure all designs comply with applicable piping codes, client specifications and project QA/QC requirements. Coordinate with structural, HVAC, electrical and BIM teams to resolve multi-discipline clashes. Participate in design reviews, document design changes. Maintain project documentation, revision control and traceability of design deliverables Support design development from initial sketches/schematics through 3D modelling, design review and final fabrication-ready deliverables. Software Tool expertise in Strong knowledge in PTC Onshape in piping design is preferable PTC Creo / SolidWorks candidates with strong piping design knowledge will also be considered. Navisworks or equivalent for clash detection Revit/BIM exposure preferred. CAESAR II basic understanding of pipe stress analysis outputs. 
 Codes & Standards expertise in ASME section VIII / B31.3 / B31.1 / B31.8, ISO 16232, DIN, AWS, ASTM / ANSI standards for pipe, fittings, flanges and material specifications as applicable. Understanding of material selection for commonly used piping materials such as stainless steel, carbon steel and other applicable materials. Understanding of applicable pipe sizing, fitting selection, valve selection and piping support requirements. 
 Required Qualifications 
 BE Mechanical Engineering degree from an accredited 4-year university or college. 5 to 8 years experience in Piping system design in Industries namely Data Centre / Liquid Cooling Preferred. HVAC / chilled water systems/ refrigeration Preferred Oil & Gas / Process Piping Considered 
 Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems. Strong leadership skills with pro-active approach Excellent communication, presentation, and technical writing skills Fluent in English Desired Characteristics

Strong customer focus approach. Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn. Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with Candor, contributes constructively. Focused: Quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed. Demonstrated creativity and ability to lead amongst peers and be accountable for team results in order to deliver a high-quality product on time.

title: Intern- UX Analyst
description:
Title: Intern- UI/UX Analyst, D2C Product 
 Who we are and Why we exist At The Whole Truth, our mission is to re-build the world s trust in its food . Consumers have lost faith in big food companies that hide behind misleading claims. We exist to change that with honesty, simplicity, and unmissable storytelling. We are India s first (and maybe only) 100% Clean Label food brand. That means we proudly declare every single ingredient on the front of the pack. But that s not all We don t just make products. We build brand love. Loudly, proudly, and consistently through content, community, and creative campaigns that break clutter. And now, we re ready to scale that brand love even further through smart, memorable, and well-placed media. That s where you come in. About The Role As Intern UI/UX Analyst, youll diagnose friction, design better user experiences, and validate improvements through data. Youre not a pure designer. Youre not a pure analyst. Youre the bridge - using session recordings, heatmaps, and funnel data to identify why customers drop off, and designing solutions to test. Key Responsibilities Session recording analysis - watch session recordings 2-3x/week to spot friction and user behavior patterns UX friction diagnosis - combine session data, heatmaps, and GA4 to build a prioritized list of improvements A/B test variant design - sketch solutions in Figma based on your findings; collaborate with the product and design teams on testing strategy Design system maintenance - collaborate with the design strategy team to document components and ensure consistency across the website Insight reporting - weekly conversion updates to the team; monthly deep dives on major findings Tool evaluation - research and recommend new UX testing tools (UserTesting, Maze, etc.) as you identify gaps in our workflow Youll collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to drive user-centric improvements across the platform. 
 Technical Capabilities Required Design Tools Prototyping: Figma proficiency (non-negotiable) - component-based design, design systems, interactive prototypes Ability to create A/B test variants quickly and hand off clean specs to engineering Understanding of mobile-first design Analytics Data Tools( good to have): GA4 -funnel visualization, event tracking, custom reports (not deep SQL, but comfortable navigating the tool) Session recording tools - session recording, heatmaps, and user behavior identification Ability to interpret data and translate findings into design improvements Basic statistical thinking (correlation vs. causation, sample size matters) Platform E-Commerce Context: Familiarity of e-commerce platforms - enough to know whats possible and whats a technical constraint Familiarity with conversion funnel - browse add-to-cart checkout payment confirmation Tools You Can Learn Suggest: Youre encouraged to research and recommend new tools that fit your workflow - UserTesting, Maze, Hotjar, Pendo , etc. You should stay current on UX testing and session recording tools 
 Functional Capabilities Required Conversion Psychology: Understand micro-interactions that drive decision-making (button color, copy, social proof, urgency) Know how to reduce friction (form fields, payment options, trust signals) Apply JTBD (Jobs to Be Done) thinking - what job is the customer hiring this product for UX Research Data Literacy: Can read a session recording and identify 3-5 UX issues Can spot patterns in heatmap data (click clusters, scroll depth, attention areas) Comfortable asking "why" - always validate assumptions with data before designing A/B Testing Iteration: Design test variants based on hypothesis, not guesswork Understand statistical rigor (sample size, test duration, confidence levels) Iterate based on results - learn from losses, compound wins Communication Collaboration: Sketch ideas quickly in Figma and get feedback early Present findings to product and design teams in a structured way Comfortable with ambiguity - youll be expected to own problems, not just execute specs Required Skills Experience UX/UI design or product analytics experience (agency, SaaS, e-commerce, or D2C preferred) Figma expertise - can create designs, components, and interactive prototypes; not a designer by training, but by fluency Conversion psychology - understand how small UX changes impact user behavior Data literacy - comfortable with GA4 funnels, segment analysis, and session recording tools Mobile-first thinking - design for phones first, then desktop India D2C context - nice-to-have but not mandatory. Understanding of Indian customer behavior, payment methods, and logistics is valuable Written communication - can document findings clearly and present to non-designers

title: Product Release Manager / Scrum Master
description:
Product Release Manager / Scrum Master Experience: 4 to 6 years
 Location: Bengaluru
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a smart, dynamic, and highly execution-oriented Product Release Manager / Scrum Master to drive the planning and execution of product releases. This role will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, internal business teams, and client teams to ensure that product initiatives and releases are planned effectively, executed smoothly, and delivered on time. The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, follows through relentlessly, is comfortable working with different stakeholders, and gets things closed . You do not necessarily need to be the most technically experienced person in the roombut you should be able to understand the work, ask the right questions, identify dependencies and risks, and ensure that everyone delivers what they have committed to. This is a highly collaborative and execution-focused role for someone who enjoys making things happen. 

 Key Responsibilities 1. Release Planning & Execution Own the planning and coordination of product releases from requirement readiness through development, QA, UAT, and production release . Work with Product and Engineering to break down requirements into actionable tasks, milestones, and release plans. Create and maintain release schedules, timelines, dependencies, and milestones. Track progress closely and ensure commitments are met. Identify delays, dependencies, and bottlenecks early and drive them toward resolution. Ensure that release activities are completed within agreed timelines. 2. Drive Engineering & QA Execution Work closely with Engineering leads, developers, and QA teams to track execution. Understand the high-level technical scope sufficiently to identify dependencies, risks, and potential delivery challenges. Conduct regular follow-ups on development and testing activities. Ensure defects, blockers, and open points are assigned and driven to closure. Escalate issues when required rather than allowing them to remain unresolved. Maintain clear visibility of what is done, what is pending, who owns it, and by when it will be completed . 3. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Support, Sales/Pre-Sales, Operations, and other internal teams as required. Ensure all teams are aligned on release scope, timelines, dependencies, and responsibilities. Coordinate activities that require inputs or actions from multiple teams. Ensure handoffs between teams happen smoothly and on time. 4. Client & Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with client teams for requirements, clarifications, UAT, feedback, and release readiness. Track client dependencies and ensure timely responses/actions from both sides. Organize and drive requirement discussions, UAT coordination, issue resolution, and release-related meetings. Maintain professional and clear communication with client stakeholders. Ensure that client commitments and open action items are actively tracked through closure. 5. Agile / Scrum Ceremonies Facilitate Scrum ceremonies such as: Sprint Planning Daily Stand-ups Sprint Reviews / Demos Retrospectives Backlog Refinement Ensure ceremonies are focused, structured, and outcome-oriented. Maintain sprint goals and ensure the team remains aligned with priorities. Track sprint commitments and proactively address slippages. 6. Tracking, Reporting & Visibility Maintain release trackers, sprint trackers, RAID logs, action-item trackers, and other project documentation as required. Provide concise and meaningful status updates to Product and leadership. Highlight: Progress against plan Delayed items Key dependencies Risks and blockers Decisions required Overall release readiness Ensure there are no surprises close to the release date . 7. Process Improvement Identify gaps in the product development and release process. Improve planning, tracking, communication, and execution practices. Establish simple and effective processes that help the team deliver consistently. Learn from previous releases and implement improvements in subsequent releases. 

 What We Are Looking For Must-Have 46 years of experience in Scrum Master, Project Management, Program/Delivery Management, Product Operations, or a similar role. Strong ownership and execution mindset. Excellent planning and organizational skills. Strong follow-up skills with a demonstrated ability to drive tasks to closure . Ability to coordinate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and parallel workstreams. Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and blockers proactively. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and changing product environment. Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
